newsitem.title: GERMANY: W.German state inflation data due from Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: W.German state inflation data due from Tuesday.

text.p: Regional west German consumer inflation data for September will be released from Tuesday, state statistics offices said on Monday.
The states of Baden-Wuerttemberg and North Rhine-Westphalia said they would probably release their data on Tuesday. Hesse said it would do so Tuesday morning or Wednesday morning.
Bavaria said it had no fixed date yet but expected to issue its figures mid-week.
Data from the four states are used to calculate preliminary west German consumer inflation, which the Federal Statistics Office has said it plans to release on Thursday or Friday.
In August, the west German consumer price index fell by 0.1 percent month-on-month and was up 1.4 percent year-on-year, according to final data released earlier this month.
Pan-German consumer prices were also down 0.1 percent in August, with a year-on-year rise of 1.4 percent.
